title: log-prepared-headers
request: can we add a debug log in StreamableHTTPTransport._prepare_headers to show the headers dict (including session ID) so it’s easier to trace request prep?
reference_diff:
--- a/src/mcp/client/streamable_http.py
+++ b/src/mcp/client/streamable_http.py
@@ -154,6 +154,7 @@
             headers[MCP_SESSION_ID] = self.session_id
         if self._protocol_version_header:
             headers[MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION_HEADER] = self._protocol_version_header
+        logger.debug("Prepared headers: %s", headers)
         return headers
 
     def _is_initialization_request(self, message: JSONRPCMessage) -> bool:
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_streamable_http_logging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+import logging
+
+import pytest
+from mcp.client.streamable_http import StreamableHTTPTransport
+
+
+def test_prepare_headers_logs_session_id(caplog):
+    transport = StreamableHTTPTransport("http://example.com")
+    transport.session_id = "test123"
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.DEBUG):
+        headers = transport._prepare_headers()
+    # Ensure the debug log was emitted and contains the session id
+    assert any("Prepared headers" in record.message for record in caplog.records)
+    assert headers.get("mcp-session-id") == "test123"
+    # Also verify the logged dict includes the session id key/value
+    assert any("test123" in record.message for record in caplog.records)
